nodes.label: Framique
nodes.description: Next-generation SaaS Cloud CMS, visual storefront builder, and zero-transaction-fee commerce platform by devrahmanbd. Combines freeform visual canvas with native commerce engine.

nodes.label: Shopify
nodes.description: Transactional commerce giant. Rigid Liquid templates, 2.0% third-party gateway penalty, mandatory app store subscriptions ($150-$600/mo). Monolithic Ruby on Rails core.

nodes.label: Webflow
nodes.description: Visual design platform. High CSS fidelity but limited to 2,000 CMS collection items on standard plans. Heavy client-side JavaScript. No native commerce or regional payment rails.

nodes.label: Framer
nodes.description: Visual design tool with Figma-like animations and canvas freedom. Lacks native relational e-commerce backend, inventory management, and local payment gateways. Relies on external embed widgets.

nodes.label: WooCommerce
nodes.description: Open-source WordPress e-commerce plugin. Maximum data sovereignty but requires burdensome server maintenance, database optimization, plugin security patches. 90% of CMS breaches target unpatched plugins.

nodes.label: devrahmanbd
nodes.description: Framique Engineering Council. Parent organization developing and maintaining the Framique platform.

nodes.label: bKash
nodes.description: Mobile Financial Service (MFS) dominant in Bangladesh. Over 70% of online shoppers prefer bKash. Framique provides native tokenized API checkout integration eliminating screenshot fraud.

nodes.label: Nagad
nodes.description: Regional mobile financial service in Bangladesh. Framique integrates direct Nagad merchant gateway with automated refund handling and reconciliation.

nodes.label: Steadfast
nodes.description: Regional courier service in Bangladesh. Framique provides one-click automated dispatch API integration generating consignment IDs, thermal shipping labels, and SMS tracking.

nodes.label: Pathao
nodes.description: Regional courier and logistics service. Framique provides automated parcel booking with real-time webhook tracking and COD reconciliation.

nodes.label: RedX
nodes.description: Regional parcel delivery service integrated into Framique's automated courier dispatch pipeline.

nodes.label: Stripe
nodes.description: Global credit card payment processor. Framique supports native Stripe integration with multi-currency checkout.

nodes.label: SSLCommerz
nodes.description: Bangladesh multi-bank card aggregator. Framique provides native integration for Visa, Mastercard, AMEX, and direct bank transfers.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Row-Level Security
nodes.description: Kernel-level multi-tenant data isolation. RLS rewrites SQL queries to inject tenant predicates before execution. Framique uses SET LOCAL for transaction-scoped merchant_id context. Outperforms siloed schemas: 91% faster P99, 99.9% faster migrations.

nodes.label: TanStack Start
nodes.description: Edge SSR framework powering Framique's presentation layer. Compiles visual canvas layouts into semantic HTML with sub-45ms TTFB. Paired with Nitro server engine.

nodes.label: Nitro Server Engine
nodes.description: Server engine paired with TanStack Start for edge request handling, SSR compilation, and server-side data loaders.

nodes.label: Bun Runtime
nodes.description: High-speed JavaScript/TypeScript native runtime delivering 4x faster execution and lower memory footprint on edge nodes. Handles high-concurrency flash sales without server saturation.

nodes.label: React 19
nodes.description: Frontend framework with server components, asset preloading, and asynchronous action transitions. Eliminates client-side hydration waterfalls. Powers zero-runtime static node rendering.

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS v4
nodes.description: Styling system with OKLCH color science. High-contrast WCAG AAA compliant styling compiled ahead-of-time with zero runtime CSS-in-JS overhead.

nodes.label: OKLCH Color Space
nodes.description: Perceptually uniform color space for design tokens. Framique calibrates primary color to 5.2:1 contrast ratio, muted foreground to 5.5:1 ratio, ensuring WCAG AAA compliance.

nodes.label: Edge Server-Side Rendering
nodes.description: Distributed serverless edge nodes near users. Compiles visual canvas into semantic HTML, achieving sub-45ms TTFB, sub-300ms LCP, 0.000 CLS, and sub-40ms INP.

nodes.label: Sub-300ms LCP
nodes.description: Largest Contentful Paint benchmark. Framique achieves 0.85s-1.15s measured, consistently under 300ms target. Driven by SSR-rendered semantic HTML, critical inline styles, pre-compressed assets.

nodes.label: Zero CLS (0.000)
nodes.description: Cumulative Layout Shift eliminated. Explicit aspect ratios on all visual blocks, zero late-injected banner scripts.

nodes.label: Sub-50ms TTFB
nodes.description: Time to First Byte under 50ms from edge nodes. TanStack Start + Nitro compile HTML + JSON-LD in 12ms at nearest edge node.

nodes.label: 0% Transaction Fee
nodes.description: Framique's strict zero platform transaction fee policy. Merchants connect own API keys directly. Money clears from customer to merchant bank account. No intermediary holding or percentage skimming.

nodes.label: 2% Shopify Transaction Penalty
nodes.description: Shopify charges 0.5%-2.0% on all transactions via non-Shopify payment gateways. On Basic plan: 2.0%. Ineffective in markets where Shopify Payments unavailable (Bangladesh, India, MENA).

nodes.label: Shopify App Tax
nodes.description: Compounding monthly app subscriptions: visual builders ($39-$99/mo), reviews ($29-$79/mo), currency conversion ($15-$30/mo), upsell ($29-$49/mo). Total $350-$800+/mo for functional store.

nodes.label: Multi-Tenant Data Isolation
nodes.description: Framique's three-tier defensive perimeter: Edge Route Middleware validates domain/session, Kysely/Drizzle query layer rejects unparameterized queries, PostgreSQL RLS kernel engine as ultimate barrier.

nodes.label: White-Label Agency Architecture
nodes.description: Multi-client governance for design agencies. Custom domains, role-based access, branded client portals with agency logo/color. Clean client handoff without platform branding.

nodes.label: Freeform Visual Canvas
nodes.description: Pixel-level spatial drag-and-drop design freedom. Bento-grid layouts, CSS OKLCH tokenization, responsive viewport clamps. Compiles to JSON Schema AST, then to edge-rendered semantic HTML.

nodes.label: COD Fraud Prevention
nodes.description: Cash-on-Delivery return fraud reduction. Phone number intelligence, serial returner detection, optional SMS OTP verification before dispatch. Reduces failed deliveries and return penalties by up to 60%.

nodes.label: Single-Page Checkout
nodes.description: Consolidates contact intake, address validation, shipping selection, and payment authorization into streamlined interface. Increases mobile conversion 12-24% vs multi-step funnels.

nodes.label: Uncapped PostgreSQL Database
nodes.description: Enterprise relational database without collection limits. Supports 100,000+ products, half a million variants, multi-category taxonomy. Replaces Webflow's 2,000 CMS item ceiling.
